narr: An anomalously moist tropical airmass resided over Virginia bringing numerous rounds of showers and thunderstorms. Thunderstorms trained over portions of central Virginia bringing rainfall amounts of two to locally six inches. This resulted in instances of flooding and flash flooding.
ev: At least 12 inches of water flowing over the road at intersection of Edward Shop Road and Corder Road.

Summerduck Road closed near Kellys Ford Road due to high water at least 6 inches deep flowing across the road.
Old Office Road closed near Black Walnut Run. Creek reported to be flowing across road at least 1-2 feet deep.
Orange Plank Road closed in front of Miller Farm due to 2 to 3 feet of standing water.
Leavells Road closed near Brezewood Drive where the Massaponax Creek intesects the road. Water reported to be 1 to 2 feet deep flowing across the road.
